root_text:
Human metapneumovirus (HMPV or hMPV) is not a novel virus.
It was first identified in 2001.
At present it is one of the most common causes of respiratory tract infection, mainly among children.
SO, HMPV IS NOT COMPARABLE WITH COVID-19. http
